input.name: images

car_n.output: output0 (1, 5, N): rows 0-3 = box centre x, centre y, width, height in input pixels (after letterbox), row 4 = class score (sigmoid already applied); no NMS inside: filter by conf, then NMS IoU 0.7 (see students/bench_cpu.py postprocess)
car_n.use: default laptop detector (real-time on one thread at 10 fps)

input.name: images
input.preprocess: resize keeping aspect so the image fits, pad with 114 grey centred, BGR->RGB, CHW, float32 / 255 (see students/bench_cpu.py letterbox)

car_s.output: output0 (1, 5, N): rows 0-3 = box centre x, centre y, width, height in input pixels (after letterbox), row 4 = class score (sigmoid already applied); no NMS inside: filter by conf, then NMS IoU 0.7 (see students/bench_cpu.py postprocess)

input.name: images
input.preprocess: resize keeping aspect so the image fits, pad with 114 grey centred, BGR->RGB, CHW, float32 / 255 (see students/bench_cpu.py letterbox); input = one car crop

panel.output: output0 (1, 5, 2100): rows 0-3 = box centre x, centre y, width, height in input pixels (after letterbox), row 4 = class score (sigmoid already applied); no NMS inside: filter by conf, then NMS IoU 0.7 (see students/bench_cpu.py postprocess)

input.name: image
input.preprocess: number box (+ the detector pad) enlarged by 10% per side (students/recog/augment.plain), resized to height 32 keeping aspect, width padded to 96 with the border mean, RGB float 0-1 (students/recog/common.to_input)

recog.output: logp (T=10, N, 11): log-probs, class 0 = CTC blank, class d+1 = digit d. Roster snap: students/recog/common.RosterScorer (P('n') + P('0n') per roster number from the CTC sequence likelihood)

car_detector.tracker: ultralytics bytetrack.yaml defaults (track_high 0.25, low 0.1, new 0.25, buffer 30 frames, match 0.8, fuse_score)
car_detector.note: 26SE at 10 fps tracking (cars_n640_v2): pass recall 0.925, precision 0.971

passes.foreground: track max box height > 0.20 H and max bottom > 0.40 H
passes.min_frames_note: frames, not seconds: 0.6 s at 10 fps
passes.nested_box_dedupe: median intersection / smaller area > 0.6 on shared frames
passes.pass_time: t0 = first frame of the pass (car enters frame); tcross = centre-line crossing

crops.selection: every track frame of the pass, evenly subsampled
crops.note: cut from the full-resolution frame (lapvision/extract.py style)

recognizer.crop_posterior: max over the crop's boxes of the roster posterior

vote.rule: ignore crops without a box; answer only if score >= tau and >= min_support boxed crops vote for the winner with P >= 0.5; else 'unknown' (send to the human reviewer)

roster.snapping: numbers outside the roster are never output

benchmark_26se.teacher: YOLO-World + VLM: pass recall 0.933, precision 0.975, end-to-end 67.9%
benchmark_26se.students_s640: recall 0.929, precision 0.967, identity no-abstain 82.7% (end-to-end 75.8%), val rule 62% coverage at 100% (end-to-end 57.1%)
